limits.cleanup_replacement: Environment reuse blocked when escaped-descendant cleanup is unproven.
limits.same_os_user_not_isolated: Private socket ownership does not isolate hostile same-user code, including project extensions.
limits.byo_journal_machine_loss: BYO journal dies with the machine.
limits.linux_not_macos: Linux results are not macOS results.
limits.peer_check: filesystem owner/mode only; no SO_PEERCRED in stock Node API
limits.receipt_retention: until explicit prototype state removal; max 512, no eviction
limits.replay: fresh authoritative snapshot on every attach, no historical event replay
limits.fence_resolution: not implemented; fenced session remains read/stop only

resource_profile: normal CLI discovery; exact loaded extension/tool inventory unverified
cleanup_profile: linux_process_group; no adoption or resume; escaped descendants unproven
